Contract CoCoMESystem::openCashDesk(cashDeskID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		currentCashDesk: CashDesk = CashDesk.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = cashDeskID),
		store: Store = currentCashDesk.BelongedStore
	precondition:
		CashDesk.allInstance()->includes(currentCashDesk) = true and
		currentCashDesk.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		currentStore.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		currentStore.IsOpened = true and
		currentCashDesk = currentCashDesk and
		currentCashDesk.IsOpened = false
	postcondition:
		result = currentCashDesk.oclIsNew() and
		CashDesk.allInstance()->includes(currentCashDesk)
}
